**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include parser dependencies in the catalog fingerprint**

When a maintenance run installs a newer allowed `lxml` release, this fingerprint remains unchanged because it hashes only files in `lcats/gettenberg/`. Since `pyproject.toml` specifies `lxml>=5.2.2` and `rdf.py` uses `lxml.etree` to produce the compiled catalog, the workflow can restore and reuse a catalog generated by a materially different parser implementation instead of rebuilding it. Include relevant dependency versions or a lockfile/environment fingerprint in the catalog cache identity.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
